items.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want
items.excerpt: The InstructMesh generative AI tool helps users 3D print working, real-world items with ease by understanding how designs should look and which edits users truly want. You can prompt the system to produce a 3D model, then ask it to edit specific parts.
items.rationale: MIT CSAIL research system (InstructMesh) where generative AI is the core result: part-level editing of AI-made 3D meshes into fabricable objects; adds an engineering/fabrication field and a fifth distinct outlet.
